summary: Refine executor prompt to explicitly mandate alternative visual inspection strategies upon roi_crop failure, targeting the recurring KeyError-induced false negatives.

edits.hypothesis: Explicitly instructing the agent to pivot to alternative visual inspection strategies (different crop, different model) when roi_crop fails will prevent it from uncritically accepting negative consensus from general VQA models, addressing the primary failure mode in q000001, q000004, and q000005.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: A plain instruction edit in the static prompt was rejected in previous rounds for not being specific enough about the 'how' of recovery; embedding the specific recovery logic in the executor's dynamic system message ensures it activates precisely when the tool-using arm is engaged and provides concrete alternatives.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for the M5 agent arm during execution, specifically reinforcing behavior when tool failures occur.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, q000004, and q000005, the agent encountered a KeyError on roi_crop. With this edit, the explicit instruction to 'attempt a different visual inspection strategy' would have prompted the agent to try a different crop box or rely more heavily on direct pixel inspection rather than defaulting to the negative consensus of llava_med_qa/chest_xray_expert. (preservative) Success habits like multi-tool triangulation are preserved as the edit encourages alternative tools/strategies rather than aborting. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where a specific high-resolution tool fails, encouraging robustness.
edits.regression_risk: May increase token usage or step count if the agent attempts multiple failed strategies, but accuracy should improve by reducing false negatives.
edits.mechanism: Explicitly instructing the agent to pivot to alternative visual inspection strategies (different crop, different model) when roi_crop fails will prevent it from uncritically accepting negative consensus from general VQA models, addressing the primary failure mode in q000001, q000004, and q000005.
